projection: EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator, spherical, R = 6378137 m). Rows run north->south, columns west->east.
pixel_convention: area: every image spans exactly the bounds below edge-to-edge; pixel (i, j) covers [west + i*W/width, west + (i+1)*W/width] etc. Pixel centres are at +0.5.

size_ground_km_at_center.note: ground metres = mercator metres * cos(lat); scale varies ~±2.5% north/south edge

heightmap.encoding: 16-bit unsigned, linear: elevation_m = min_m + value / 65535 * (max_m - min_m). heightmap.png = 16-bit grayscale PNG; heightmap_u16le.bin = the same values as raw little-endian uint16, row-major, width*height, no header.
heightmap.despike_note: isolated terrarium spike/pit pixels (> max(40 m, 0.9 px) above/below all 8 neighbours) replaced by the neighbour median

hillshade.note: 8-bit hillshade computed from the heightmap (sun azimuth 315 deg, altitude 40 deg, no exaggeration).

imagery.source: USGS The National Map - USGSImageryOnly (orthoimagery, USDA NAIP at large scales)

imagery_grade_night.note: imagery.jpg colour-graded (tools/map_grade.py): cold, desaturated, darker, matte blacks. Same pixels/bounds as imagery.jpg.
imagery_grade_night.source: USGS The National Map - USGSImageryOnly (orthoimagery, USDA NAIP at large scales)
